_comment: The changes a typed request may make to a user, and the value each accepts. A request names a change by its id and supplies a value; nothing else is accepted, and the script is the only thing that runs (Book 15, Chapter 12, task 5). Copy and edit at work. Every change is refused on a user synchronized from on-premises: its source of authority is the on-premises directory, so the change belongs there or in the HR record (Microsoft Learn, Update user).
